spans.s:
m. (-रिः)
1 An enemy.
2 A wheel.
3 A species of Khadira or Mimosa.
E.
ऋ to go, अच् affix, and इ substituted for अ.

n. (-लं)
Family of an enemy.
E.
अरि, and कुल family.

mfn. (-भाक्)
Not entitled to a share of the property, a non-heir.
E.
अ neg. रिक्थभाज a co-heir.

f. (-ता)
Enmity, hostility.
E.
अरि and तल् affix, also with त्व, अरित्वं.

n. (-त्रं)
A rudder.
E.
ऋ to go, and इत्रन् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Gratifying an enemy, affording triumph to an enemy.
E.
अरि, and नन्दन what delights.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Conquering, victorious.
E.
अरि, and दम to tame, affix खच्.

n. (-रं)
An enemy's town or country.
E.
अरि, and पुर a city.

m. (-त्रः)
An ally or friend of an enemy.
E.
अरि, and मित्र a friend.

m. (-दः)
A fetid Mimosa, (M. Farnesiana.)
E.
अरि an enemy, and मेद what injures.

n. (-ष्ट्रंः)
An enemy's country.
E.
अरि, and राष्ट्र a country.

m. (-कः)
A hostile tribe or an enemy's country.
E.
अरि, and लोक a country.

m. (-षः)
1 Disease arising from meat and drink.
2 A stream of water from the clouds.

m. (-ष्टः)
1 The soap-berry plant, (Sapindus saponaria, &c.)
2

Garlick.
3

The Nimb tree, (Melia azadirachta.)
4 A crow.
5 A heron.
6 The name of an Asura or infernal spirit.
n. (-ष्टं)
1 A woman's apartment, the lying-in chamber.
2 Good fortune, happiness.
3 Bad or ill luck, misfortune.
4

Buttermilk.
5

Vinous spirit.
6 Sign or symptom of approaching death.
7 A portent, some natural phenomenon considered as indicating calamity.
E.
अ neg. and रिष्ट bad or good fortune.

m. (-कः)
The soap-berry plant, (Sapindus saponaria, &c.)
E.
अ neg. and रिष्ट affliction, क affix; relieving sickness, &c. See the preceding, of which it may have all the meanings.

mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति)
Auspicious, making fortunate or happy.
E.
अरिष्ट, तन to spread, and डाति aff.

mfn. (-धीः-धीः-धि)
Apprehensive of death, alarmed at its approach.
E.
अरिष्ट sign of death, टुष्ठ disturbed, and धी understanding, mind; whose is so.

m. (-मिः)
The twenty-second of the twenty-four Jaina Tīrthakaras or saints. Also नेमि.

m. (-नः)
A name of KṚṢṆA or VIṢṆU.
E.
अरिष्ट the Asura so named, and सूदन who destroys; having killed the demon ARIṢṬA.

n. (-कं)
Consternation, defeat.
E.
अरि, and स्थानक being in place.

m. (-कः)
An avenger.
E.
अरि, and हिंसक who injures.
